Container.Name: Faster-Qwen3-TTS-Wyoming
Container.Overview: Local Faster Qwen3-TTS with a WebUI, an OpenAI-compatible streaming API, and an integrated Wyoming TTS adapter for Home Assistant. Both interfaces share one NVIDIA GPU model instance.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: Qwen Qwen3 TTS Wyoming Home Assistant speech voice CUDA OpenAI
Container.Requires: Unraid 6.12 or newer, the NVIDIA Driver plugin, a CUDA-capable NVIDIA GPU, and internet access for the first model download. The default 1.7B model is recommended for quality; use the 0.6B CustomVoice model for lower VRAM usage.

Config.Name: Qwen WebUI and API Port
Config.Description: Gradio WebUI and OpenAI-compatible TTS API.

Config.Name: Wyoming TTS Port
Config.Description: Wyoming protocol endpoint for Home Assistant.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Hugging Face, Gradio, and Torch caches.

Config.Name: Qwen3-TTS Model
Config.Description: Hugging Face model identifier. Use Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice for the default quality profile or Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-CustomVoice for lower VRAM usage.

Config.Name: Default Voice
Config.Description: Default CustomVoice speaker. Supported: aiden, dylan, eric, ono_anna, ryan, serena, sohee, uncle_fu, vivian.

Config.Name: Language
Config.Description: Qwen synthesis language.

Config.Name: Instruct
Config.Default: Speak naturally, clearly, and warmly in English. Use a calm, fluent pace, lively but restrained prosody, and natural sentence pauses. Articulate sibilants and numbers clearly. Avoid monotonous intonation, exaggerated emotion, and dramatic pitch changes.
Config.Description: Default instruction applied to TTS requests without their own instruction.

Config.Name: Temperature
Config.Description: Sampling temperature. Lower values are calmer and more stable.

Config.Name: Top P
Config.Description: Nucleus sampling probability.

Config.Name: Top K
Config.Description: Number of token candidates used during sampling.

Config.Name: Repetition Penalty
Config.Description: Penalty used to reduce repeated speech artifacts.

Config.Name: Sampling Enabled
Config.Description: Enable stochastic token sampling.

Config.Name: Seed
Config.Description: Default random seed for reproducible requests.

Config.Name: Maximum New Tokens
Config.Description: Upper generation limit per text segment.

Config.Name: Non-Streaming Mode
Config.Description: Keep false for incremental PCM generation.

Config.Name: Streaming Chunk Size
Config.Description: Model token chunk size used for streaming output.

Config.Name: Token Safety Margin
Config.Description: Multiplier used when estimating the segment token budget.

Config.Name: Maximum Segment Characters
Config.Description: Long text is split into bounded segments at natural boundaries.

Config.Name: Segment Pause Milliseconds
Config.Description: Silence inserted between long-text segments.

Config.Name: Pending Queue Limit
Config.Description: Maximum queued synthesis requests.

Config.Name: Backend
Config.Description: Faster Qwen3-TTS inference backend.

Config.Name: Device
Config.Description: Inference device. The default image is intended for CUDA.

Config.Name: Torch DType
Config.Description: Torch model dtype.

Config.Name: Attention Implementation
Config.Description: Torch attention implementation.

Config.Name: GGML Quantization
Config.Description: Quantization passed to the GGML backend.

Config.Name: Force Language
Config.Description: Always synthesize using the configured language.

Config.Name: Startup Timeout Seconds
Config.Description: Maximum first-start model download and initialization time.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Host user ID used for appdata files.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Host group ID used for appdata files.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
Config.Description: NVIDIA GPU selection.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
Config.Description: Required NVIDIA driver capabilities.
